title: 鉄骨構造
subtitle: Steel Structure
keywords: Characteristics of steel 2.Structural design 3.Design of main frames 4.Design of nonstructural members 5.Construction
educationalGoal: Steel structures are a commonly applied structural type in Japan. Students learn the basic characteristics of steel materials, steel structural design, construction, etc., necessary to safely build steel structures, and they develop skills that can be applied to actual design and construction based on this knowledge.
advice: Using the textbook, we will cover the following topics: 1. Introduction to the subject and features of steel structures 2. Characteristics of steel 3. Explanation of a sample building to analyze 4. Design of members for axial force 5. Design of members for bending moments 6. Beam design 7. Column design 8. Brace design 9. Structural joints 10. Design of structural joints 11. Column base design 12 Nonstructural member design 13. Construction of steel structures
books: Comprehensive structural design for steel structure Writen byJapanese Society of Steel Construction Publisher: Gihodo shuppan Co., Ltd.
requiredKnowledge: Since lectures will proceed on the premise that students have credit for "Structural Mechanics for Architecture I" and "Structural Mechanics for Architecture II", if students have forgotten or need to better understand the contents of these subjects, they must review appropriately.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the features of steel structures and the concepts of their design.
Students can design members using beam and column design formulas.
Students can design braces using a brace design formula.
Students can explain the types of structural joints and their characteristics and can design.
Students can explain the main points of steel construction.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students understand more than 80% of the contents of the textbooks, understand the characteristics of steel structures, structural design, and the components of construction, and can conduct structural design from structural planning to design of each member, referring to the textbook.
achievementLevels.standard: Students understand more than 60% of the contents of the textbooks, and generally understand the characteristics of steel structures, structural design, and construction.

lessons.content: Introduction (How the course proceeds) -History of steel structures -Characteristics of steel structures -Types of steel structures
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report, and self- reflection
lessons.assignments: Review section 1 of the textbook Prepare section 2 of the textbook, and work on the 1st report

lessons.content: Characteristics of steel materials -Types of carbon steel -Yield strength and ultimate tensile strength -Design flow of steel structures
lessons.assignments: Review section 2 of the textbook Prepare section 10.1 and 10.2 of the textbook, grasp the outline of the sample building, and read from section 3.1 to section 3.6

lessons.content: Explanation of a sample building to analyze -How to read architectural drawings -How to read structural drawings -Loads and external forces -How to read cross section force diagrams
lessons.assignments: Review to understand the sample building by studying its drawings Prepare sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.5, and 6.1-6.3 of the textbook

lessons.content: Design of members for axial force -Buckling of rods -Buckling of plates, and width-thickness ratio -Design of tensile members -Design of compression members
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report, and self- reflection
lessons.assignments: Review sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.5, and 6.1-6.3 of the textbook Prepare sections 5.3 and 5.4 of the textbook, work on the 2nd report

lessons.content: Design of members for bending moments -Lateral buckling
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, and self- re flection
lessons.assignments: Review sections 5.3 and 5.4 of the textbook Prepare section 6.4 of the textbook

lessons.content: Beam design -Cross-sectional force in beam -Design formulas for beam design -Allowable bending stress -Lateral buckling stiffeners
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report, and self- reflection
lessons.assignments: Review section 6.4 of the text book Prepare section 6.5 of the textbook, work on the 3rd report
Review: correct mistakes in problems Prepare section 6.6 of the textbook

lessons.content: Column design -Cross section forces in columns -Design formulas for column design -Allowable bending stress
lessons.assignments: Review section 6.5 of the text book Prepare for the midterm test

lessons.content: Brace design -Role of braces and basics of brace design -Design formula for brace design
lessons.assignments: Review section 6.6 of the text book Prepare section 7 of the textbook

lessons.content: Structural joints -Bolted joints -High strength bolted joints -Welded joints
lessons.assignments: Review section 7 of the textbook Prepare sections 8.1-8.5 of the textbook

lessons.content: Design of structural joints -Concept of structural joints -Design of structural joints
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report, and self- reflection
lessons.assignments: Review sections 8.1-8.5 of the textbook Prepare section 8.6 of the textbook, work on the 4th report

lessons.content: Column base design -Base plate type -Embedded type -Concrete-encased type
lessons.assignments: Review section 8.6 of the textbook Prepare section 6.7 of the textbook, prepare for the final test
Review: correct mistakes in problems Prepare: read the reserved book and watch the DVD

lessons.content: Nonstructural member design -Slab design -Design of other members
lessons.assignments: Review section 6.7 of the textbook Prepare for the final test
Review construction procedures for steel structures and develop your image for construction
